a: Turning coords off leaves an in-flight read free to refill the coord list, so stale coords reappear when it is turned back on
A predicted, handled record with no `fired` reads "handled" in the trace row but "would handle" in its decision path
`defaultOpen` opens a grouped category but never its group, so the category stays hidden under a closed parent
b: A grouped category's parent branch badges how many categories it holds, not how many entries, so a filter's matches under a group go uncounted there
The live row's expanded state outlives the live record, so it reopens on its own when a prediction returns
